seeds: 1000..1015; previous batch = immediately preceding same policy/surface result

definitions.mainCardMedianKm: Median over nonempty group first-card great-circle distances; even count averages middle pair.
definitions.groupsOver30Km: Groups with at least one result whose distance is strictly greater than 30 km.
definitions.uniqueResults: Distinct IDs within one 16-batch sequence; aggregate uses mean per sequence.
definitions.repeatAppearances: Total appearances minus distinct IDs within each sequence; summed over independent sequences.
definitions.primaryOpportunities: Experience appearances in profiles with explicit interests; no-interest profiles excluded.
definitions.groupMatches: Experience groupSizes includes selection; Place uses existing positive placeGroupSignal.
definitions.exactBudgetMatches: Structured price equals selected band; indifferent budget never counted as exact.
definitions.averageDurationFit: Existing durationFitSignal mean per sequence, Experience only.

limitations: Synthetic preference profiles; embedded verified coordinates, not fresh GPS or independently re-surveyed locations. Straight-line distance is not travel time. No new acceptance thresholds; no native/device/release claim.
